test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was leading the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) until March 2025, after which key reforms stalled?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Debasish Panda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Debasish Panda**, a **1987-batch** **IAS officer** of the **Uttar Pradesh** cadre, was appointed as the **Chairperson** of the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** in **March 2022**.
 
• His appointment was approved by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)** for a tenure of **three years**, which concludes in **March 2025**.
 
• Before joining IRDAI, **Debasish Panda** served as the **Secretary** in the **Department of Financial Services (DFS)** under the **Ministry of Finance**, **Government of India**, where he retired in **January 2022**.
 
• Under his leadership, the regulatory body shifted its focus toward a **principle-based regime** rather than a rule-based one, aiming to enhance the **ease of doing business** in the insurance sector.
 
• He has been a key proponent of the vision **"Insurance for All by 2047"**, a mission intended to ensure that every citizen and enterprise in **India** has appropriate insurance coverage by the centenary of **Independence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About IRDAI:**
 
 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** is a **statutory body** formed under the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999**.
 
• It functions as the apex body to regulate and develop the **insurance** and **re-insurance** industries in **India**.
 
• The body consists of a **10-member** team, including a **Chairman**, **five whole-time members**, and **four part-time members**, all appointed by the **Government of India**.
 
• While it was initially headquartered in **New Delhi**, the head office was shifted to **Hyderabad**, **Telangana**, in **2001** to facilitate better regional administration.
 
 
 
• **Major Initiatives under current leadership:**
 
 
• **Bima Sugam:** This is a conceptualized **one-stop digital platform** designed to integrate all insurance stakeholders, including companies, agents, and consumers, to simplify the purchase and claim process.
 
• **Bima Vahak and Bima Vistaar:** These initiatives aim to reach the **rural** and **gram panchayat** levels to improve insurance **penetration** in under-served areas.
 
• **Risk-Based Capital (RBC):** IRDAI is working on transitioning from a factor-based solvency model to a **risk-based capital framework** to align Indian standards with **global** best practices.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Malhotra Committee:** The **IRDAI** was established following the recommendations of the **Malhotra Committee** report of **1994**, which suggested reforms to open up the insurance sector to private players.
 
• **Regulatory Duties:** As per **Section 14** of the **IRDA Act, 1999**, the authority is tasked with protecting the interests of **policyholders** and ensuring the orderly growth of the insurance market.
 
• **Other Options:** 
 
 
• **Sunil Mehta** is a prominent banker who served as the **Chief Executive** of the **Indian Banks' Association (IBA)**.
 
• **Subhash Chandra Khuntia** was the immediate **predecessor** of **Debasish Panda**, serving as **IRDAI Chairman** from **2018** to **2021**.
